finalText:
**Redis died, and the cache-less app ate itself.**

`02:14:07` — `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`. Cache fell back to direct store reads.

Store then took every read. Timeouts at 5000ms started 3 seconds later. Queue depth climbed steadily, past `max 500` at `02:29:12` ([logs/app.log:647](logs/app.log:647)).

13 reconnects, `attempt 0` to `attempt 12`, all refused, all ~80s apart. Redis never came back.

`02:31:44` — `worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory`, exited 134. `02:31:52` — supervisor killed `api`, service down.

Next: find why Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connections. The app never recovered on its own.
